title: Retreat Picks
eyebrow: GPOM second half · scene A · picks
heading: After the stand-down: a wide retreat
intro: Round 2. You picked rt-01, but the video model wouldn't turn the bots round: in all four takes they kept driving the way their noses pointed, right, toward the door. So here is rt-01 again with every bot already turned to face down-left, away from the door, and the concrete block painted out. The clip then just carries them on down the hill. Pick one. Claude's pick: rt-01c-2.

sections.lede: Same camera and light as your pick; the bots already face away from the door.

groups.title: Retreat start frame
groups.line: Pick one; the clip continues them down the slope.

opts.label: rt-01c-2: closest to your rt-01 layout; three turned, one finishing its turn in the chalk crescent (Claude's pick)
rt-01c-1: all four turned and rolling, each with its own chalk loop
opts.warn: the pack is rearranged into one even line, a bit like a parade

opts.label: rt-01c-3: bunched, heavy dust rolling up toward the door
opts.warn: the fourth bot is half lost in the dust; bots drawn bigger

opts.label: for reference: rt-01b, your pick cleaned up (bots still facing right: this is the one that wouldn't turn)

sections.lede: The shot before it (the stand-down, sd-01) and the shot being replaced (V10r, at the door).

opts.label: now: V10r, filing away at the door

sections.lede: Pick one. A note on the row is welcome.

groups.title: Retreat (replaces V10r)
groups.line: Wide, far from the door, turning away.

opts.label: rt-01: high wide from the ridge by the bunker, pack well down the hill and turning, one mid-pivot in a chalk crescent (Claude's pick)
opts.warn: a stray concrete block in the foreground reads as a second pillbox; easy to paint out

opts.label: rt-02: low long lens in the grass, the nearest bot swinging round, clods flying
opts.warn: least wide; may read as too close again

opts.label: rt-03: steep aerial, chalk hairpin loops where they turned, door tiny
opts.warn: the slope has gone flat; loops look designed

opts.label: rt-04: the wide approach's own camera, pack higher up heading down-left
opts.warn: the turn isn't legible; feels like a repeat of the approach

opts.label: rt-05: extreme wide from the next hill over a fence post, pack fanning out down the slope. The widest, the clearest retreat; bots tiny
rt-06: from the bunker doorway looking down at them filing away
opts.warn: doors are open here (shut everywhere else); single file echoes V10r
